enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Wake up briefly. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping. Wake up at 7:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and taking a hot shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Turn off water heater. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making toast and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Take out toaster. Insert bread into toaster. Press toaster lever. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Take out jam. Place on counter. Kettle boils. Turn off kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Put on plate. Spread butter on toast. Spread jam on toast. Sit at kitchen table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish breakfast. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Wiping the counters and loading breakfast dishes into the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes from table. Scrape food scraps into bin. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa watching morning TV and scrolling the news on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through articles. Read article. Tap on article. Scroll more. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone again. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the shops and buying groceries for the long weekend
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up keys and wallet. Open door. Lock door. Walk to shops. Enter shop. Pick up basket. Select groceries. Place in basket. Go to checkout. Pay. Receive groceries. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and putting food away in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Place bags on counter. Open bag. Take out items. Open refrigerator. Place milk in refrigerator. Place vegetables in crisper. Place meat in meat drawer. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Place dry goods in cupboard. Close cupboard. Fold bags. Put bags away.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a simple lunch with the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch at the kitchen table
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up lunch dishes and wiping down the stove
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape scraps into bin. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Close dishwasher. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe stove. Rinse cloth. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the TV on and the air conditioner running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Lie back. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk with the DeskLamp on to draft community program plans for next week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on DeskLamp. Open computer. Press power button. Wait for boot. Open document. Type notes. Scroll. Type more. Save document. Open email. Check email. Close email. Open calendar. Check schedule. Close calendar. Save document. Close computer. Turn off DeskLamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an afternoon walk in the park and stopping for a coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up keys. Open door. Lock door. Walk to park. Walk along path. Sit on bench. Look around. Stand up. Walk to coffee shop. Enter shop. Order coffee. Pay. Receive coffee. Drink coffee. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up with a second shower and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out comfortable clothes. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and heating bread in the oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn on oven. Place bread in oven. Set timer. Stir vegetables. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Check bread. Take bread out of oven. Turn off oven.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner while listening to a podcast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up phone. Open podcast app. Select podcast. Press play. Pick up fork. Eat. Drink water. Pick up phone. Skip segment. Put down phone. Continue eating. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and running the dishwasher after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape scraps into bin. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Close dishwasher. Add detergent. Press start button. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Wipe counters.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a film on TV and playing a short session on the GameConsole
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select film. Press play. Watch film. Pick up GameConsole controller. Turn on GameConsole. Play game. Pause game. Put down controller. Watch film. Pick up controller again. Play game. Turn off GameConsole. Put down controller. Watch film.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on the phone with the Fan on for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Turn on Fan. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Select book. Read. Scroll. Turn page. Read. Adjust pillow. Turn off Fan. Put down phone. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to other side. Continue sleeping.
